name: Isaiah
overview: The book of Isaiah, authored by the prophet Isaiah son of Amos during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, reveals God's dealings with Judah and Jerusalem amid political and spiritual turmoil. Isaiah's ministry includes comforting King Hezekiah during his illness and confirming God's promise through the miraculous reversal of the shadow on the sundial, demonstrating the Lord's sovereign power and faithfulness. The prophet invites sinners to repentance with the assurance of divine forgiveness, promising cleansing even for the most grievous sins, thus pointing forward to God's redemptive mercy.
